descriptions.agent: Ask a research question or describe a strategy in your own words.
descriptions.portfolio: See balances and holdings across connected accounts.
descriptions.alphaZoo: Explore stock-selection signals and evaluate their historical performance.
descriptions.optionsLab: Build option strategies, explore payoff and risk, and browse US option chains.

instructions.reports: Ask the research assistant to backtest a strategy first, then open its results here. Download PDFs and other chat-generated documents from the original conversation.
instructions.portfolio: Add and enable an account source, then refresh its holdings. This page provides a read-only account overview.
instructions.alphaZoo: Read a factor definition, then choose a market and date range to evaluate or compare signals. Validate candidates with a backtest.
instructions.optionsLab: Choose a preset or add option legs, then adjust price, expiry, and volatility; results update automatically. The stock symbol for the live chain is separate from the simulation inputs.
instructions.correlation: Enter at least two asset symbols, choose a lookback window, then select Compute.
instructions.scheduled: Enter a research instruction, choose its cadence, and save. The local scheduler must be enabled for jobs to run; delivery also needs a configured channel.
instructions.runtime: Configure a broker connection in Settings or Portfolio first. Available trading actions depend on that broker's capabilities and your authorization.
instructions.settings: Configure a model to start. Add data sources or broker connections as your task needs them; public-market research does not require a broker account.

runtime.title: وضعیت زنده / شبیه‌سازی (Paper)
runtime.subtitlePost: . این صفحه کانکتورها را مجاز نمی‌کند، رانرها را راه‌اندازی یا متوقف نمی‌کند، سفارش ثبت یا لغو نمی‌کند و ماندیت را تغییر نمی‌دهد.
runtime.unavailableHint: تا زمانی که بک‌اند وضعیت به‌روزی ارائه ندهد، ران‌تایم کانکتور را غیرقابل‌اعتماد فرض کنید.
runtime.noProfilesBody: بک‌اند هیچ پروفایل زنده یا شبیه‌سازی شناخته‌شده‌ای از کارگزارها برنگردانده است.
runtime.riskHaltedDesc: کلید قطع برای این پروفایل فعال شده است. تا پاک‌شدن وضعیت، ران‌تایم کانکتور را متوقف فرض کنید.
runtime.riskActiveDesc: رانر زنده است و ماندیت منقضی‌نشده‌ای وجود دارد. این صفحه همچنان فقط وضعیتِ فقط‌خواندنی است.
runtime.riskIdleDesc: مجوز و ماندیت موجودند، اما رانر زنده نیست.
runtime.riskDormantDesc: ران‌تایم کانکتور برای عملیات خودکار آماده نیست؛ مجوز، ماندیت یا زنده‌بودن رانر ناقص است.
runtime.missingLongbridgeVariables: پیکربندی ناقص است. این متغیرها را در agent/.env تنظیم کنید و سرویس را دوباره بسازید:
runtime.missingEtoroVariables: پیکربندی ناقص است. این متغیرهای محیطی را تنظیم کنید یا فایل ~/.vibe-trading/etoro.json بسازید:
runtime.missingEtoroFileHint: فایل نمونه: {"api_key": "کلید عمومی شما", "user_key": "کلید کاربری شما", "profile": "live-readonly"}. پروفایل‌ها: etoro-paper-sdk، etoro-live-sdk-readonly، etoro-paper-trade، etoro-live-trade.
runtime.missingConnectorVariables: پیکربندی ناقص است. اعتبارنامه‌های کانکتور را در ~/.vibe-trading/ یا agent/.env تنظیم کنید و اتصال را راستی‌آزمایی کنید.
runtime.diagnosticCredentialsPartial: اعتبارنامه‌ها ناقص‌اند. همه متغیرهای لازم را تنظیم کنید و سرویس را دوباره بسازید.
runtime.diagnosticCredentialsConflict: منابع اعتبارنامه در تضادند. یک منبع کامل نگه دارید و دوباره تلاش کنید.
runtime.diagnosticSdkMissing: SDK لانگ‌بریج در سرویس بک‌اند نصب نیست.
runtime.diagnosticAuthenticationFailed: احراز هویت ناموفق بود. اعتبارنامه‌های پیکربندی‌شده را بررسی کنید.
runtime.diagnosticNetworkUnreachable: سرویس لانگ‌بریج در دسترس نیست. دسترسی شبکه را بررسی کنید و دوباره تلاش کنید.
runtime.diagnosticBrokerError: کارگزار درخواست راستی‌آزمایی فقط‌خواندنی را رد کرد. دوباره تلاش کنید یا لاگ‌های بک‌اند را بررسی کنید.

examples.thesisTrackerPrompt: از مهارت thesis-tracker برای ساخت تِزیس سرمایه‌گذاری مائوتای کوئی‌جو (600519.SH) استفاده کن: تِزیس مرکزی ۵ جمله‌ای، فرض‌های ابطال‌پذیر، خطوط قرمز و لنگرهای ارزش‌گذاری، با financial_rigor راستی‌آزمایی شود

examples.quoteTrendDesc: دریافت نرخ لحظه‌ای و کندل‌های روزانه اخیر از کانکتور انتخاب‌شده

client_id.label: Client ID (AppKey)
client_id.help: The app's AppKey from the Credentials page of the DingTalk developer console.

client_secret.label: Client Secret (AppSecret)

allow_from.label: Allowed senders
allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of DingTalk sender IDs that may talk to the agent ("*" allows everyone). Unpaired senders receive a pairing code in a direct message.

allow_remote_media_redirects.label: Allow remote media redirects
allow_remote_media_redirects.help: Follow provider redirects when downloading message media. Off by default.

remote_media_redirect_allowed_hosts.label: Allowed redirect hosts
remote_media_redirect_allowed_hosts.help: Hosts allowed when remote media redirects are enabled. An empty list blocks every cross-host redirect.

group_user_isolation.label: Per-user group sessions
group_user_isolation.help: Give each member of a group chat their own agent session instead of sharing one.

force_ipv4.label: Force IPv4
force_ipv4.help: Bind DingTalk API calls to IPv4. Useful when the app's egress-IP whitelist holds a stable IPv4 address while the IPv6 prefix keeps rotating.

app_id.label: AppID
app_id.help: The bot's AppID from the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com) app settings.

secret.label: AppSecret
secret.help: The bot's AppSecret. Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

allow_from.label: Allowed senders
allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of QQ sender openids that may talk to the agent ("*" allows everyone). Unpaired senders receive a pairing code in a direct message.

ack_message.label: Ack message
ack_message.help: Immediate acknowledgement sent when a message arrives. Leave empty to disable.

media_dir.label: Media directory
media_dir.help: Where inbound attachments are saved. Empty uses ~/.vibe-trading/media/qq.

download_chunk_size.label: Download chunk size
download_chunk_size.help: Bytes per chunk when downloading attachments (default 262144).

download_max_bytes.label: Max download size (bytes)
download_max_bytes.help: Safety cap for a single attachment download (default 209715200 = 200 MB).

consent_granted.label: Consent granted
consent_granted.help: Master permission switch. The channel reads and sends email only after you explicitly grant consent here.

imap_host.label: IMAP host
imap_host.help: Inbound mail server host, e.g. imap.gmail.com. Incoming mail is polled from this server.

imap_username.label: IMAP username
imap_username.help: Mailbox account used to sign in over IMAP, usually the full email address.

imap_password.label: IMAP password
imap_password.help: Mailbox password or app password for IMAP. Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

imap_mailbox.label: IMAP mailbox
imap_mailbox.help: Mailbox folder polled for new mail (default INBOX).

imap_use_ssl.label: IMAP SSL
imap_use_ssl.help: Connect to IMAP over SSL (on by default; required for port 993).

imap_use_tls.label: IMAP STARTTLS
imap_use_tls.help: When IMAP SSL is off, upgrade the connection with STARTTLS before logging in (on by default; typical for port 143). Turn it off only for a server that offers no TLS on a network you trust — the password is then sent in plain text.

smtp_host.label: SMTP host
smtp_host.help: Outbound mail server host, e.g. smtp.gmail.com. Replies are sent through this server.

smtp_port.label: SMTP port
smtp_port.help: Outbound port (default 587 with STARTTLS; use 465 for implicit SSL).

smtp_username.label: SMTP username
smtp_username.help: Account used to authenticate with the SMTP server, usually the full email address.

smtp_password.label: SMTP password
smtp_password.help: Password or app password for SMTP. Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

smtp_use_tls.label: SMTP STARTTLS
smtp_use_tls.help: Upgrade the SMTP connection with STARTTLS (on by default; typical for port 587). In practice this is mutually exclusive with SMTP SSL.

smtp_use_ssl.label: SMTP SSL
smtp_use_ssl.help: Connect to SMTP over implicit TLS, e.g. port 465 (off by default). In practice this is mutually exclusive with STARTTLS.

verify_tls.label: Verify TLS certificate
verify_tls.help: Verify the mail server's TLS certificate and hostname (recommended). Disable only for self-signed or internal-CA servers.

from_address.label: From address
from_address.help: Address replies are sent from. Empty reuses the SMTP username.

auto_reply_enabled.label: Automatic replies
auto_reply_enabled.help: Reply automatically to inbound email. Proactive sends started by the agent are unaffected.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval_seconds.help: How often the IMAP mailbox is checked for new mail (default 30, floor 5).

mark_seen.label: Mark as seen
mark_seen.help: Mark processed emails as read in the mailbox.

post_action.label: After processing
post_action.help: What happens to processed emails: delete, move them to another mailbox, or leave empty to keep them.

post_action_move_mailbox.label: Move to mailbox
post_action_move_mailbox.help: Target mailbox used when After processing is set to move.

post_action_expunge.label: Expunge after delete
post_action_expunge.help: Permanently expunge deleted emails instead of leaving them flagged in the mailbox.

post_action_ignore_skipped.label: Skip self and filtered mail
post_action_ignore_skipped.help: Leave skipped emails (your own messages and senders filtered by the allowlist) untouched by the post-action (on by default).

max_body_chars.label: Max body chars
max_body_chars.help: Truncate each email body to this many characters (default 12000).

allow_from.label: Allowed senders
allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of email addresses that may talk to the agent ("*" allows everyone). Unpaired senders receive a pairing code in a reply.

verify_dkim.label: Verify DKIM
verify_dkim.help: Require an Authentication-Results header with dkim=pass. Disabling both DKIM and SPF accepts spoofed From headers.

verify_spf.label: Verify SPF
verify_spf.help: Require an Authentication-Results header with spf=pass. Disabling both DKIM and SPF accepts spoofed From headers.

allowed_attachment_types.label: Allowed attachment types
allowed_attachment_types.help: MIME allowlist for inbound attachments, e.g. application/pdf or image/*. Leave empty to disable attachments.

max_attachment_size.label: Max attachment size (bytes)
max_attachment_size.help: Largest single attachment accepted, in bytes (default 2000000 = 2 MB).

max_attachments_per_email.label: Max attachments per email
max_attachments_per_email.help: How many attachments are accepted from one email (default 5).

trusted_authserv_id.label: Trusted authentication server
trusted_authserv_id.help: Receiver authserv-id, e.g. mx.google.com. Your mail provider must strip incoming forged Authentication-Results headers bearing this ID. Required when SPF or DKIM verification is enabled; blank rejects inbound mail.

pdf_password.label: PDF report password
pdf_password.help: Optional password for scheduled PDF reports that explicitly request protection. Stored server-side and never included in scheduled jobs or returned to the browser.

host.label: Bind host
host.help: Local address the WebSocket server binds to (default 127.0.0.1, local-only). A wildcard host such as 0.0.0.0 or :: exposes the server on every interface and is rejected unless a token or token-issue secret is set.

port.label: Bind port
port.help: Local port the WebSocket server listens on (default 8765). Ignored when a Unix socket path is set.

unix_socket_path.label: Unix socket path
unix_socket_path.help: Optional absolute path. When set, the server listens on this Unix socket instead of the host and port.

path.label: Upgrade path
path.help: WebSocket upgrade path clients connect to (default /). Must start with "/".

token.label: Static token
token.help: Shared secret checked as the token query parameter during the handshake. Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

token_issue_path.label: Token issue path
token_issue_path.help: HTTP GET route that hands out short-lived one-time tokens as JSON. Must differ from the upgrade path.

token_issue_secret.label: Token issue secret
token_issue_secret.help: Bearer secret the token-issue route requires (Authorization: Bearer or X-Vibe-Trading-Auth). Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

token_ttl_s.label: Issued token TTL (s)
token_ttl_s.help: Lifetime of a token handed out by the token-issue route, in seconds (30-86400, default 300).

websocket_requires_token.label: Require token
websocket_requires_token.help: Reject handshakes that do not present a valid static or issued token (on by default).

allow_from.label: Allowed clients
allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of client IDs that may connect ("*" allows everyone, the default).

streaming.label: Stream output
streaming.help: Stream model output deltas to connected clients as they are generated.

max_message_bytes.label: Max message bytes
max_message_bytes.help: Largest inbound frame accepted, in bytes (default 37748736; range 1024-41943040).

ping_timeout_s.label: Ping timeout (s)
ping_timeout_s.help: Seconds to wait for a ping reply before dropping the connection (5-300, default 20).

ssl_certfile.label: TLS certificate path
ssl_certfile.help: PEM certificate path on the server for WSS. Set both certificate and key, or neither; these are file paths on the server, not uploaded material.

ssl_keyfile.label: TLS key path
ssl_keyfile.help: PEM private key path on the server for WSS. Set both certificate and key, or neither; these are file paths on the server, not uploaded material.

app_secret.label: App Secret

encrypt_key.label: Encrypt Key

verification_token.label: Verification Token
verification_token.help: The Verification Token from the Event Subscription settings. Optional for long-connection mode.

allow_from.label: Allowed senders
allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of Feishu sender IDs that may talk to the agent. Leave empty to allow everyone the bot can see.

react_emoji.label: Working emoji
react_emoji.help: Emoji reacted on an incoming message while the agent works (default THUMBSUP).

done_emoji.label: Done emoji
done_emoji.help: Emoji reacted when the task completes. Leave empty for none.

tool_hint_prefix.label: Tool hint prefix
tool_hint_prefix.help: Prefix shown before inline tool hints in the reply.

group_policy.label: Group policy
group_policy.help: "mention" replies only when the bot is @mentioned in groups, "open" replies to all group messages.

reply_to_message.label: Quote the original message
reply_to_message.help: Quote-reply to the original message when answering.

domain.label: Domain
domain.help: "feishu" for Feishu China (open.feishu.cn), "lark" for international Lark (open.larksuite.com).

topic_isolation.label: Per-topic sessions
topic_isolation.help: Give each group topic its own agent session instead of sharing one session per group.

bot_token.label: Bot token (xoxb-)
bot_token.help: The Slack bot user OAuth token (starts with xoxb-). Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

app_token.label: App token (xapp-)
app_token.help: The Slack app-level token (starts with xapp-) with the connections:write scope, required for Socket Mode. Stored server-side and never sent back to the browser.

user_token_read_only.label: User token read-only
user_token_read_only.help: A behavior flag, not a credential: keeps user-token access read-only.

reply_in_thread.label: Reply in thread
reply_in_thread.help: Reply in a thread under the original message instead of posting directly to the channel.

react_emoji.label: Working emoji
react_emoji.help: Emoji reacted on an incoming message while the agent works (default eyes).

done_emoji.label: Done emoji
done_emoji.help: Emoji reacted when the task completes (default white_check_mark). Leave empty for none.

include_thread_context.label: Include thread context
include_thread_context.help: Prepend earlier replies from the thread as context the first time the bot is pulled into it.

thread_context_limit.label: Thread context limit
thread_context_limit.help: Maximum number of thread messages included as context (default 20).

allow_from.label: Allowed senders
allow_from.help: Allowlist of Slack user IDs permitted to talk to the agent. DM and channel access are further controlled by the DM policy and the group policy.

group_policy.label: Group policy
group_policy.help: "mention" replies only when the bot is @mentioned in a channel, "open" replies to all channel messages, "allowlist" replies only in the channels listed below.

group_allow_from.label: Allowed channels
group_allow_from.help: Channel IDs the bot responds in when the group policy is "allowlist".

group_require_mention.label: Require mention in allowed channels
group_require_mention.help: With the "allowlist" policy, also require an @mention before replying in approved channels. No effect for "mention" or "open".

allow_from.help: Optional allowlist of Discord user IDs that may talk to the agent. Leave empty to allow everyone.

allow_channels.label: Allowed channels
allow_channels.help: Optional allowlist of Discord channel IDs the bot responds in. Leave empty to allow every channel.

intents.label: Gateway intents
intents.help: Gateway intent bitfield as an integer (default 37377 = GUILDS | GUILD_MESSAGES | DIRECT_MESSAGES | MESSAGE_CONTENT). MESSAGE CONTENT is a privileged intent that must be enabled in the Developer Portal or the bot fails to connect.

group_policy.help: "mention" replies only when the bot is @mentioned in a server channel, "open" replies to all channel messages (still subject to the allowlists).

read_receipt_emoji.label: Read receipt emoji
read_receipt_emoji.help: Emoji reacted on an incoming message right away to acknowledge it (default 👀); removed once the reply arrives.

working_emoji.label: Working emoji
working_emoji.help: Emoji reacted while the agent is still working (default 🔧), added after the working emoji delay.

working_emoji_delay.label: Working emoji delay (s)
working_emoji_delay.help: Seconds to wait before adding the working emoji, so quick replies never show it (default 2.0).

dingtalk.title: DingTalk setup guide
dingtalk.intro: DingTalk bots use Stream Mode, so no public callback URL is needed.
dingtalk.step1: Create an app in the DingTalk developer console (open-dev.dingtalk.com).
dingtalk.step2: Add the bot capability to the app and enable Stream Mode for it.
dingtalk.step3: Copy the app's AppKey into Client ID and its AppSecret into Client Secret.
dingtalk.step4: Publish the app so it is available to your organization.
dingtalk.step5: Return here, click Test connection, then enable the channel.

qq.title: QQ setup guide
qq.intro: QQ bots connect over WebSocket via the official botpy SDK, so no public callback URL is needed.
qq.step1: Register on the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com) and create a bot.
qq.step2: Copy the AppID and AppSecret from the bot's development settings page.
qq.step3: Paste them into the AppID and AppSecret fields above.
qq.step4: Add the bot to a QQ group or chat with it privately, following the platform's sandbox/publish rules.
qq.step5: Return here, click Test connection, then enable the channel.

email.title: Email setup guide
email.intro: The email channel polls a mailbox over IMAP for incoming mail and replies over SMTP, so no public callback URL is needed.
email.step1: Get the IMAP and SMTP host names and ports from your mail provider (usually imap.<provider> on 993 and smtp.<provider> on 587).
email.step2: Enable IMAP and SMTP access in your mailbox settings and, if the provider requires one (Gmail, QQ Mail and other 2FA providers), create an app password.
email.step3: Fill in the IMAP and SMTP credentials above, set From address, and add your own address to Allowed senders.
email.step4: Click Test connection — it probes the IMAP login, the mailbox folder, and the SMTP login.
email.step5: Tick Consent granted, then enable the channel; automatic replies then reach senders whose mail passes the DKIM/SPF checks.

websocket.title: WebSocket setup guide
websocket.intro: The WebSocket channel runs its own local server that clients connect to directly over a WebSocket URL, so no public callback URL is needed.
websocket.step1: Choose a bind address: keep 127.0.0.1 for local-only use, or set 0.0.0.0 / :: to expose the server — a wildcard host requires a token or a token-issue secret.
websocket.step2: Set a static token, or a token-issue path plus its bearer secret so clients can request short-lived tokens.
websocket.step4: Saving while the channel is running hot-swaps the server: connected clients (including this Web UI chat) briefly disconnect and reconnect.
websocket.step5: Click Test connection — it validates the SSL certificate/key material and the address availability locally.

feishu.title: Feishu / Lark bot setup
feishu.intro: Feishu bots connect over a WebSocket long connection, so no public IP or webhook URL is needed.
feishu.step1: Create a Custom App on the Feishu Open Platform (open.feishu.cn), or scan-to-create it from the terminal with vibe-trading channels login feishu, which saves the App ID and App Secret automatically.
feishu.step2: Add the Bot capability to the app.
feishu.step3: Under Event Subscription, subscribe to receiving messages (im.message.receive_v1) and choose Long Connection mode.
feishu.step4: Copy the App ID and App Secret from Credentials & Basic Info and paste them into the fields above.
feishu.step5: Create a version and publish the app (admin approval if your tenant requires it), then enable the channel here — it hot-applies with no restart. For international Lark tenants, set domain to "lark".

discord.title: Discord setup guide
discord.intro: Discord bots connect over the gateway with a bot token, so no public IP or webhook URL is needed.
discord.step1: Create an application in the Discord Developer Portal (discord.com/developers).
discord.step2: Open the Bot page, reset the token, and copy it.
discord.step3: Under Privileged Gateway Intents, enable MESSAGE CONTENT INTENT — the default intents require it.
discord.step4: Generate an OAuth2 invite URL with the bot (and applications.commands) scope and add the bot to your server.
discord.step5: Paste the token here, click Test connection, then enable the channel.

alphaZoo.title: آلفا زو
alphaZoo.browseDesc: سیگنال‌های مقطعی فرمول‌محور از Qlib، مجموعه ۱۰۱ کاکوشادزه، GTJA 191، ادبیات ناهنجاری‌های دانشگاهی و بنیادی‌های PIT-safe را مرور کنید. روی هر آلفا کلیک کنید تا فرمول و کد منبعش را ببینید، یا بنچ بگیرید تا کل زو را روی یک جهان و دوره امتیازدهید.

zooCardDesc.academic: ناهنجاری‌های افق بلند گزینش‌شده از ادبیات دانشگاهی (ارزش، مومنتوم، کیفیت، کم‌نوسان و…).

home.title: پژوهش استراتژی کمّی با هوش مصنوعی

home.featureBacktestDesc: منابع داده متعدد پوشش‌دهنده تحلیل کمّی سهام A

home.step2Title: ۲. پژوهش و بک‌تست را تماشا کنید
home.step2Desc: ایجنت برنامه می‌ریزد، داده بازار می‌کشد و بک‌تست را زنده اجرا می‌کند تا هر گام را دنبال کنید.
home.step3Desc: متریک‌های عملکرد، منحنی ارزش حساب و Pine Script قابل‌خروجی استراتژی را ببینید.

connections.oauthNote: از OAuth استفاده می‌کند؛ در صورت نیاز از طریق اتصال دوباره مجاز کنید.
connections.localNote: اعتبارنامه‌ها توسط پیکربندی موجود کانکتور محلی مدیریت می‌شوند.
connections.savedVault: اعتبارنامه‌ها در خزانه سیستم‌عامل ذخیره شدند.
connections.accountNone: No account selected. This connection reads nothing until you choose one.

analysis.chainOnDemand: Load market quotes when needed; payoff calculation uses the premiums you enter.
analysis.assetsValidation: Enter 2–20 distinct assets, separated by commas, spaces or semicolons.
analysis.regimeMethod: Regimes use Pearson correlation; the selected method applies to the matrix.
analysis.factorSelectionHint: Select one factor to evaluate, or a few to compare. A full zoo takes longer.
analysis.resultLimit: Rows to display (does not reduce computation)
analysis.evaluationScope: Will evaluate {{count}} factor(s) across a stock universe.
analysis.ready_public_data: Uses public data. Availability is checked when the task runs.
analysis.ready_tushare_ready: Tushare is configured. CSI 300 also needs daily, adjustment-factor and historical constituent permissions.
analysis.ready_tushare_token_missing: CSI 300 needs a Tushare token and data permissions. Configure it in Settings or use S&P 500.
analysis.ready_tushare_dependency_missing: Install the Tushare dependency, or use S&P 500.
analysis.ready_single_asset: BTC-USDT is one asset; cross-sectional IC needs a stock universe. Choose CSI 300 or S&P 500.
analysis.backgroundJob: You can leave this page and return to this task while the server stays running.
analysis.streamInterrupted: Connection interrupted. Reconnect to retrieve progress and results.
analysis.jobExpired: Task expired or the server restarted. Start a new evaluation.
analysis.no_data: No bars for this symbol and date range
analysis.factorCoverage: Prices fetched for {{count}} of {{total}} requested stocks.
analysis.survivorshipBias: Current index constituents are used; historical results have survivorship bias.
analysis.degradedUniverse: The index roster could not be obtained; this run uses a smaller disclosed fallback universe.
analysis.selectedFactor: Selected factor: {{id}}. Only this factor will be evaluated.
analysis.fundamentalsRequirement: Fundamental factors need PIT SEC financial statements and a US stock universe (S&P 500).
analysis.noEvaluableFactors: No factors could be evaluated. Try a longer history and check the factor’s required fields and stock universe.

customProviders.saved: Provider saved in the local credential vault
customProviders.title: Custom OpenAI-compatible providers
customProviders.description: Add any provider with a compatible chat-completions API. The key is tested before saving, then kept in the OS credential vault.
customProviders.empty: No custom providers yet. Add one below and test it before saving.
customProviders.idHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores.
customProviders.label: Display name
customProviders.urlHint: Use the API root. Do not include an API key in the URL.
customProviders.saveHint: Save unlocks only after a successful test. Activation is a separate confirmed action.
customProviders.waiting: The provider is taking longer than usual ({{seconds}}s). The request will continue until the server timeout.
